{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun traps''' were [[Ssi-ruu]]k technology used for internal security. The Ssi-ruuk installed stun traps aboard their [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to keep the enslaved [[P'w'eck]]s in line and prevent mutinies.<ref name="TABS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
